protocol.purpose: Investigate native H1 checkpoint publication failures with actual CPU PPO; preserve existing working tree as baseline.
protocol.gpu_tasks: No GPU training while shared GPU occupied; CPU simulations and learner only.

training.admission: Admit both baseline/candidate paths together before the time cutoff. Never shorten an admitted path. Outcomes do not affect the queue.
limits: Native H1 evaluation starts at deterministic nominal pose; seed does not create independent initial states.
This is software publication parity, not an algorithm comparison.
Elapsed times on the shared host are not a performance benchmark.

recovery.start_after: All admitted fresh-training pairs and their evaluations finish successfully.
recovery.fault: Send SIGTERM to the training process immediately after the second real checkpoint rename, at update 100; the production handler converts it to KeyboardInterrupt.
recovery.comparison: Compare fault/interruption continuation pair and legacy continuation pair, including optimizer state and every non-timing metric.
recovery.limits: Environment and RNG reset by native H1 resume contract; not equivalent to uninterrupted training.

provenance.change: Record the validated source checkpoint SHA256 in resumed run metadata; clarify stopped-run CLI help.
provenance.comparison: Exact non-timing training metrics and checkpoint state; recorded input SHA must match the actual input file.
